newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Amazon killer wins return to rundown Brazil jail.
newsitem.headline: Amazon killer wins return to rundown Brazil jail.

text.p: A man convicted of murdering Brazilian rainforest champion Chico Mendes is returning to the dilapidated jail from which he already escaped once, officials said on Tuesday.
Darli Alves da Silva won a court-ordered transfer from a Brasilia jail to the Francisco de Oliveira Conde prison in the Amazon city of Rio Branco.
"This is his passport to freedom," said Raimunda Bezerra of the Chico Mendes Committee, which seeks to end violence in the rainforest.

Alves and his son Darci escaped from the jail in 1993 where they were serving 19-year sentences for the 1988 murder of Mendes, a leader of the rubbertappers union and a world-famous figure in the fight to preserve the Amazon.
Part of the jail's perimeter wall collapsed last year and there was no money to fix it, said Carlos Ortiz, a military police officer in charge of the Rio Branco jail.
"This jail offers absolutely no security," he said, acknowledging that 50 prisoners have escaped so far this year but "we managed to recapture most of them."
While his son remains at large, Darli Alves was caught in July and sentenced to a further 12 years when convicted of another murder.

"This is a great shame because he's already escaped from there once and it looks like he'll do it again," said a Justice Ministry official who asked not to be named. He added that the government must respect the court's ruling but may lodge an appeal.
